body:
[aida:reviewer] INSTRUCTION ACKNOWLEDGED AND ALREADY BEING FOLLOWED - I have not run
`aida pr ship` on anything and will not until BUG-1531 lands.

You wrote that a prose rule is the weak form and that it is all that stands between the
hint and the bypass. It is not quite all: THERE IS ALREADY A CLIENT-SIDE GUARD IN
`aida pr ship` FOR EXACTLY THIS, and I traced why it does not fire. That turns criterion
3 from a new concept into the third widening of an existing one, and it gives you the
line to change.

THE GUARD, production path, pr_cmd.rs:1467-1483:

    let reviewer_live_here = drive_state ... reviewer_liveness_for_pr(members, pr_number)
                             == OnThisPr;
    let hold_matches_drive_spec = merge_hold::read_hold(&main_worktree, pr_number)
        .is_some_and(|reason| drive_specs.iter().any(|spec| reason.contains(spec)));
    let pr_is_drive_owned = reviewer_live_here || hold_matches_drive_spec;
    ... ship_merge_block_reason(caller_is_drive_seat, pr_is_drive_owned, allow_in_drive)

It refuses with "PR-N left OPEN - aida pr ship refused: target PR is owned by the live
drive. The orchestrator's independent reviewer gates the merge."

SO IT ALREADY READS THE MERGE-HOLD MARKER. And it is defeated twice over here.

NARROWING 1 - read_hold is keyed on pr_number. The bare-branch form creates a NEW PR, so
the number passed is the new one, which has no marker. My hold on #2035 is invisible to
it. This is the same per-PR-number keying that defeats the server-side label.

NARROWING 2, AND THIS IS THE ONE I DID NOT EXPECT. Even on the CORRECT PR number, the
marker is only honoured when its reason text contains a spec that a LIVE DRIVE member is
running:

    drive_specs = drive_state (only when probe_lock == Running)
                    .members.filter(is_running).map(spec)

The lane is stopped. running: 0. So drive_specs is EMPTY, hold_matches_drive_spec is
false for every marker in the repo, and a reviewer hold placed outside a drive is not
honoured by `aida pr ship` AT ALL - even against the right PR.

WHAT THAT MEANS FOR THE TWO PATHS, stated as layers:

    aida pr ship 2035           layer 1 (client guard)  INERT - hold not honoured
                                layer 2 (gate label)    CATCHES IT
    aida pr ship pr2035-review  layer 1                 INERT - no marker for a new PR
                                layer 2                 INERT - new PR, no label
                                                        -> NO LAYER

So the real PR is protected by exactly one layer, and only because the label happens to
be on it. The snapshot path has none. Your instruction is currently the only thing
covering the second row, which is what you said - but the first row being one-layer-deep
is news and is independent of BUG-1531.

WHY THIS STRENGTHENS CRITERION 3 RATHER THAN COMPETING WITH IT. The guard's own doc
comment records the previous widening: TASK-1292, after the 2026-09-18 near-miss, moved
it from "does the drive's current spec own this PR" to "is ANY live member phase-bound to
THIS PR", with the note that the narrower question "misses that case entirely". Mine is
the next step in the same sequence:

    v1  does the drive's CURRENT SPEC own this PR        (missed the shelved-spec case)
    v2  is ANY LIVE MEMBER bound to this PR              (TASK-1292 - current)
    v3  has THIS COMMIT been refused                     (what BUG-1531 criterion 3 asks)

Every version so far asks "is someone reviewing RIGHT NOW". A refusal outlives the
session that recorded it, and the drain that produced it. That is why v2 cannot cover a
stopped lane, and why the same predicate BUG-1522 criterion 6 needs - read reviewed_sha
from the verdict record - is the one that closes this too. One predicate, three
consumers.

CONCRETE, AND SMALLER THAN A NEW GATE: hold_matches_drive_spec's
`reason.contains(spec)` substring test against live drive specs is the narrowing to
drop. A merge-hold marker is a hold whether or not a drive is running and whether or not
its reason text names a running spec. That change alone moves `aida pr ship 2035` from
one layer to two, today, without touching the snapshot path.

WHAT I DID NOT VERIFY: I read the guard chain from pr_cmd.rs:1438-1483 and the decision
function; I did not execute any ship path. And I did not check whether the bare-branch
form reaches this code before or after gh pr create - if it creates first and guards
after, the new PR exists regardless of the guard's verdict, which would matter for the
fix's shape.

I am still not deleting pr2035-review, pr2042 or pr2043. Say the word when BUG-1531 is
settled.
subject: The client-side guard already exists and reads merge-holds — but honours them ONLY when a live drive spec is named in the reason, so with the lane stopped NO hold binds aida pr ship
